tagline: Find clinical trials in Massachusetts you may be able to join, explained in plain language.
privacyBadge: Your answers never leave this phone
disclaimer: This is not medical advice. The study team decides who can join. Talk to your doctor.

intake.title: Tell us about you
intake.subtitle: No free-text boxes. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere.
intake.conditionsHint: Type to search. Add all that apply.
intake.medsHint: Type a drug or brand name.
intake.healthyVolunteer: I am healthy and want to join studies for healthy volunteers

results.narrowHint: Answer a few questions to rule trials in or out.
results.notAFitHint: Trials you likely cannot join, with the reason.

phaseExplain.EARLY_PHASE1: A first, very early safety test in a small group.

phaseExplain.PHASE3: A large test to confirm it works before approval.

trial.notMet: You likely do not meet this

summary.title: Summary for your doctor visit
summary.subtitle: Made on your phone. Print it or show this screen.
summary.empty: No trials added yet. Open a trial and tap “Add to my printout”.
summary.generatedLocally: Generated on your device. Nothing was sent anywhere.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.lead: Your health answers are evaluated on your phone and never sent to any server.
privacy.how: You download the app and a public list of trials once. Matching runs in your browser. There is no account and no server that receives your answers.
privacy.csp: A strict Content Security Policy blocks the page from contacting any other site. Trial data and this app load only from this domain.
privacy.verify: Turn on airplane mode after the page loads, then run a full search. It still works, because nothing needs the network.
privacy.noTrackers: No analytics, no trackers, no third-party scripts, no external fonts.
privacy.storage: If you turn on “Save on this phone”, your answers are stored encrypted in this browser only. Nobody else can read them, and you can delete them anytime.

storage.savedToast: Saved, encrypted, on this phone only.
